title: Yellow Dense Slovakian Sweet Red Peppers Casserole
description: A dense and resinous Slovakian dish featuring sweet red peppers, perfect for a date night, and is vegetarian friendly. This casserole is a hearty and flavorful option for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sweet red peppers and cook until they start to soften.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the tomato paste and vegetable broth.
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the cooked peppers and onions.
Pour the tomato paste mixture over the peppers and onions.
Top with the shredded cheddar cheese.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
